value: Validates PyTorch CUDA matmul/conv2d against CPU FP64 within rtol/atol across yaml op/dtype/shape cases

#1: Max absolute error across correctness cases (max_abs_error); #2: Maximum relative L2 error (max_rel_error); #3: Tolerance-compliant case percentage (tolerance_compliance); #4: Test case coverage count (coverage_count); #5: Test case failure count (failure_count)
Run local PyTorch CUDA matmul/conv2d correctness checks versus a CPU FP64 reference. Does not run pytest or the official PyTorch Operator Correctness test_ops.py suite

Run local PyTorch CUDA matmul and conv2d for each yaml op_name/dtype/shape, compare each GPU result to a CPU FP64 reference using rtol/atol, and emit pass_rate_percent plus error counts, to measure tensor-op numerical correctness. Does not invoke pytest or GitHub test_ops.py

For each yaml op_name, dtype, and shape, run the CUDA matmul or conv2d and compare it to a CPU FP64 reference using rtol and atol. Emit pass rate plus absolute error, relative error, coverage, and failure count. Does not run pytest or GitHub test_ops.py

Dispatches scripts/collect_tensor_ops.py to compare GPU matmul/conv2d against a CPU FP64 reference. device_id: torch CUDA device. op_name: yaml matmul,conv2d. dtype: yaml tokens f16_r, bf16_r, f32_r (smoke f16_r; baseline/extended f16_r,bf16_r,f32_r). shape: tensor dimensions. rtol/atol/tolerance_rel: comparison gates. num_iterations: randomized inputs per case. seed: RNG seed. This is not pytest test_ops.py
CSV from collect_tensor_ops.py with one row per op/dtype/shape case

The run exits 0. A case that fails allclose is status=error; the summary row stays status=ok and carries failure_count

Each case is compared with a CPU FP64 reference. max_rel_error is the difference norm divided by max(reference norm, atol). tolerance_compliance on the summary is the percent of cases that passed. The CSV is one row per case plus a summary row
